baton_acceptance.label: DeepSeek native Harness provider-free structured diagnostic native-boot observability rehearsal acceptance

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Exact Git objects in an Ariadne receipt must come only from the machine snapshot, not free-form source-evidence prose.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first preexecution runtime state repeated the full candidate Git object in git_refs_and_worktree prose.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The Ariadne preflight returned revision_required with git_refs_evidence_manual_object_id_forbidden before native launch.

correction.action: Remove the object from prose, preserve the rejected receipt and rerun preflight before process start.
correction.prevention_control: Receipt prose names the active candidate semantically while full objects are supplied only through typed active_operation fields and resolved by the machine snapshot.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected manual Git-object prose and corrected machine-owned receipt binding.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The final prelaunch reading must parse and complete before the one-process authority can be consumed.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first composite reading embedded a semicolon inside an invalid parenthesized expression and PowerShell rejected it during parsing.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: PowerShell emitted Missing closing parenthesis before controller or native process execution.

correction.action: Decompose candidate ancestry and protected-ref collection into explicit assignments and require the deterministic check to exit zero first.
correction.prevention_control: Lifecycle-critical prelaunch readings use simple sequential assignments rather than nested native-command expressions.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the prelaunch parser rejection and passing decomposed reading before the only native process.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A provider-free pytest command manifest must pass only literal repository-relative test files accepted by the wrapper.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The checkpoint manifest appended a pytest -k selector that the provider-free wrapper does not admit.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The post-terminal wrapper invocation rejected the unrecognized arguments before pytest collection.

correction.action: Run the exact acceptance set as whole literal files and include the package materialisation fixture once.
correction.prevention_control: Future provider-free command manifests use literal file paths only unless a separately reviewed typed selection contract exists.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the inadmissible pytest selector and the passing 64-test whole-file allowlist.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every clockwork incident observation must use one exact stage from the engine's closed vocabulary.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first closeout intent used preexecution for two incident stages even though the clockwork vocabulary represents that phase as dispatch.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The read-only clockwork check rejected with tick_incident_stage before transaction preparation, command execution or publication.

correction.action: Replace the two invalid stage values with the exact dispatch vocabulary and rerun the unchanged read-only transaction.
correction.prevention_control: Closeout incident stages are selected from the engine-owned closed vocabulary before the first clockwork check.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected noncanonical incident stage and corrected typed clockwork observation.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every generated successor latch must retain the canonical closed-surface token required by baton consistency.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first published successor boundaries expressed the closed ordinary-practice posture but omitted the exact no_ordinary_practice_enablement_feature_flag_allowlist_or_command_mounting token.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The postpublication current-baton consistency suite failed the exact protected-boundary subset assertion.

correction.action: Roll back the uncommitted generation byte-exactly, add the canonical token and republish the corrected bundle.
correction.prevention_control: Successor boundary construction retains the baton test's canonical closed-surface subset in addition to tranche-specific constraints.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the postpublication boundary-token rejection and byte-exact rollback before corrected publication.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A byte-exact rollback restores canonical and metadata bytes while its incremented pointer lease must be committed before another generation is prepared.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first corrected dry-run was attempted immediately after rollback without first binding the incremented rollback lease in Git.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The read-only clockwork check rejected with tick_pointer_physical_drift before transaction preparation or command execution.

correction.action: Commit only the clockwork-owned incremented pointer lease, then prepare the corrected generation from that source.
correction.prevention_control: The rollback procedure now treats the byte-exact restoration and its monotonic lease commit as one required precursor to any replacement generation.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected post-rollback dry-run and the explicit rollback-lease commit before corrected publication.
